entries.title: fix(desktop): enforce agent mention authorization at send boundaries
entries.rationale: Accepted as a high-value authorization hardening change, queued for Zion-preserving adaptation. The fail-closed directory and owner-proof behavior must remain intact across send, edit, and deferred-upload boundaries.
security_reasons: agent mention authorization at send and edit boundaries
fail-closed behavior while managed/relay directories load or error
owner-only fresh ownership proof and revocation handling
human mention preservation when agent authorization is denied or unknown

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated authorization threat review, focused revocation and deferred-upload tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, focused authorization tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
